// Optional fixture extraction from an external, pinned Loki checkout. This
// authored tool reads Go syntax; it does not copy or execute upstream test code.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "4b16bc4fa823f7ec6e865ebf51fad89d98a2371c"
const sourcePath = "pkg/storage/stores/shipper/indexshipper/tsdb/single_file_index_test.go"

type stream struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Bytes  []int64           `json:"chunk_bytes"`
}

type volume struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Bytes int64  `json:"bytes"`
}

type testCase struct {
	Name     string   `json:"name"`
	Line     int      `json:"source_line"`
	Query    string   `json:"query"`
	Targets  []string `json:"targets"`
	Limit    int64    `json:"limit"`
	Expected []volume `json:"expected"`
	Excluded string   `json:"excluded,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: go run extract_volume.go LOKI_CHECKOUT > volume-upstream.json")
	}
	path := filepath.Join(os.Args[1], sourcePath)
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	check(err)
	hash := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	if hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]) != "39503947f978f862aeb8e5db5879831f95acf7d03092ce75952ccdc2b8940b30" {
		panic("upstream test source differs from pinned Loki v3.5.0")
	}
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	file, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, path, raw, 0)
	check(err)
	var body *ast.BlockStmt
	for _, decl := range file.Decls {
		if fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && fn.Name.Name == "TestTSDBIndex_Volume" {
			body = fn.Body
		}
	}
	if body == nil {
		panic("upstream volume test missing")
	}
	streams := []stream{}
	for _, stmt := range body.List {
		assignment, ok := stmt.(*ast.AssignStmt)
		if !ok || assignment.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name != "series" {
			continue
		}
		for _, item := range assignment.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			fields := fields(item)
			labels := map[string]string{}
			text := str(fields["Labels"].(*ast.CallExpr).Args[0])
			for _, pair := range regexp.MustCompile(`(\w+)=("[^"]*")`).FindAllStringSubmatch(text, -1) {
				labels[pair[1]], err = strconv.Unquote(pair[2])
				check(err)
			}
			bytes := []int64{}
			for _, chunk := range fields["Chunks"].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
				bytes = append(bytes, number(fieldsOf(chunk, "KB"))*1024)
			}
			streams = append(streams, stream{labels, bytes})
		}
	}

	cases := []testCase{}
	ast.Inspect(body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
		if !ok || method(call) != "Run" || str(call.Args[0]) != "aggregate by labels" {
			return true
		}
		ast.Inspect(call.Args[1], func(n ast.Node) bool {
			run, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if !ok || method(run) != "Run" {
				return true
			}
			c := testCase{Name: str(run.Args[0]), Line: fset.Position(run.Pos()).Line, Targets: []string{}, Expected: []volume{}}
			matchers := []string{}
			ast.Inspect(run.Args[1], func(n ast.Node) bool {
				inner, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
				if !ok {
					return true
				}
				if method(inner) == "Run" { // A grouping test, not a leaf.
					return false
				}
				switch method(inner) {
				case "MustNewMatcher":
					op := map[string]string{"MatchEqual": "=", "MatchRegexp": "=~"}[inner.Args[0].(*ast.SelectorExpr).Sel.Name]
					if op == "" {
						panic("unsupported matcher")
					}
					name := str(inner.Args[1])
					if name != "" { // Loki's internal match-all sentinel becomes {}.
						matchers = append(matchers, name+op+strconv.Quote(str(inner.Args[2])))
					}
				case "SetChunkFilterer":
					c.Excluded = "Loki-only chunk-filter callback; no public Pulse equivalent"
				case "Volume":
					if _, ok := inner.Args[3].(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
						c.Excluded = "Loki estimates partial chunk overlap; Pulse counts exact selected line bytes"
					}
					if targets, ok := inner.Args[7].(*ast.CompositeLit); ok {
						for _, target := range targets.Elts {
							c.Targets = append(c.Targets, str(target))
						}
					}
				case "withTenantLabelMatcher":
					matchers = append([]string{"__loki_tenant__=" + strconv.Quote(str(inner.Args[0]))}, matchers...)
				case "Equal":
					response := fields(inner.Args[1].(*ast.UnaryExpr).X)
					c.Limit = number(response["Limit"])
					for _, item := range response["Volumes"].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
						c.Expected = append(c.Expected, volume{str(fieldsOf(item, "Name")), number(fieldsOf(item, "Volume"))})
					}
				}
				return true
			})
			if c.Limit != 0 {
				c.Query = "{" + strings.Join(matchers, ",") + "}"
				cases = append(cases, c)
			}
			return true
		})
		return false
	})
	if len(streams) != 3 || len(cases) != 10 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected fixture shape: %d streams, %d cases", len(streams), len(cases)))
	}
	out := map[string]any{
		"revision": revision, "source": sourcePath, "source_sha256": hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]),
		"streams": streams, "cases": cases,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	check(enc.Encode(out))
}

func method(call *ast.CallExpr) string {
	switch fn := call.Fun.(type) {
	case *ast.SelectorExpr:
		return fn.Sel.Name
	case *ast.Ident:
		return fn.Name
	}
	return ""
}

func fields(expr ast.Expr) map[string]ast.Expr {
	result := map[string]ast.Expr{}
	for _, item := range expr.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		pair := item.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		result[pair.Key.(*ast.Ident).Name] = pair.Value
	}
	return result
}

func fieldsOf(expr ast.Expr, key string) ast.Expr { return fields(expr)[key] }

func str(expr ast.Expr) string {
	value, err := strconv.Unquote(expr.(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
	check(err)
	return value
}

func number(expr ast.Expr) int64 {
	switch value := expr.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		n, err := strconv.ParseInt(value.Value, 0, 64)
		check(err)
		return n
	case *ast.ParenExpr:
		return number(value.X)
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		switch value.Op {
		case token.ADD:
			return number(value.X) + number(value.Y)
		case token.MUL:
			return number(value.X) * number(value.Y)
		}
	}
	panic("unsupported upstream number expression")
}

func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
